name: Ayanokouji Mizuho
source:
She is a successor to the Eastern art of Onmyodo, and comes to this school to avenge her parents. She helps progress though this adventure by transforming into small animals such as cats or mermaids, but naturally, this often means losing her clothes and the embarrassment that it causes. She is a cheerful girl, but because of the purpose of her visit, she has a somewhat gloomy air about her.

Her specialty is natural magic. Her weapon is the sword. Once you become proficient, you can use two swords at the same time.
